step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram displays data telemetry flowing from Smart TVs (UserConsumerMobile) into AWS for processing and visualization. The visual components include: 1) A Smart TV icon (UserConsumerMobile) sending telemetry data (logs, perf, user) to Kinesis Data Streams (KinesisDataStream). 2) Kinesis Data Streams pointing to Kinesis Data Firehose (Firehose). 3) Kinesis Data Firehose writing data to Amazon S3 (S3) for long-term storage and to Amazon Redshift (RedShift) for data warehousing. 4) Amazon Redshift feeding into Amazon QuickSight (QuickSight) for business intelligence and reporting.
